name: ghost-prompt
description: Ghost-text completions for your Copilot prompts — write faster, think clearer.
author: JaminSmoke

ghostPrompt.suggestionModelPolicy.markdownDescription: Policy to choose Copilot model for inline suggestions. `nonPremiumOnly` (safe default) avoids premium-capable models; `anyModel` allows first available model and may consume premium quota.

ghostPrompt.selectedModelId.markdownDescription: Preferred model id for inline suggestions. Use `auto` to let GhostPrompt choose based on policy.

ghostPrompt.debugSuggestions.markdownDescription: Enable structured debug logs for suggestion lifecycle in the `GhostPrompt Suggestions` output channel.

ghostPrompt.maxSuggestionChars.markdownDescription: Maximum number of characters for each inline suggestion after normalization.

ghostPrompt.suggestionStyle.markdownDescription: Controls how specific and long inline suggestions should be. `concise` keeps short continuations, `balanced` keeps practical context-rich responses, `detailed` allows richer multi-sentence continuations.

ghostPrompt.contextMode.markdownDescription: Controls whether context is used to shape inline suggestions. `off` disables context, `basic` uses recent session prompt/suggestion signals, `project` also includes lightweight active workspace/file context.

ghostPrompt.suggestionLanguageMode.markdownDescription: Language mode for suggestions. `auto` detects language from current input, `manual` forces the configured suggestion language.

ghostPrompt.suggestionLanguage.markdownDescription: Suggestion output language used when `ghostPrompt.suggestionLanguageMode` is `manual`.

ghostPrompt.minCharsForSuggestion.markdownDescription: Minimum normalized character count required before requesting a suggestion.

ghostPrompt.requestCooldownMs.markdownDescription: Minimum cooldown between repeated identical suggestion inputs.

ghostPrompt.cacheTtlMs.markdownDescription: How long suggestion cache entries are kept in memory (milliseconds).

ghostPrompt.rateLimitMaxRequests.markdownDescription: Maximum suggestion requests allowed within the configured rate limit window.

ghostPrompt.rateLimitWindowMs.markdownDescription: Window size in milliseconds used by rate limiting.

ghostPrompt.sessionRequestBudget.markdownDescription: Maximum number of suggestion model requests allowed per extension session.

scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run compile
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run test
